import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

f13 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0013.png').convert('RGB'))

# Find couch right edge in f13:
couch = (f13[:, :, 0] > 70) & (f13[:, :, 0] < 120) & (f13[:, :, 1] > 80) & (f13[:, :, 1] < 130) & (f13[:, :, 2] > 90) & (f13[:, :, 2] < 140)
couch[:, 120:180] = False # exclude lamp pole
y, x = np.where(couch)
print('Couch in F13: x in', x.min(), x.max(), 'y in', y.min(), y.max())
for y_val in range(y.max()-5, y.max()+1):
    xs = x[y == y_val]
    print(f'Couch y={y_val}: xs from {xs.min()} to {xs.max()}')
"
